name: Cairn Linnorm OLD
savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 15 (Deactivated by Cold Iron)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity (Tail Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
Tail only

See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Curse of the Crooked Cane
defensiveAbilities.description: When a creature slays a cairn linnorm, it must succeed at a DC 44 Will Saving Throw save or become permanently Enfeebled 2. In addition, the victim ages at an accelerated rate, aging 1 year every day, eventually causing it to die of old age if the curse is left untended.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The cairn linnorm expels a 60ft Cone of void energy-infused acid, dealing 19d6 Acid Damage damage to creatures in the area (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save). The acid also saps the life out of affected creatures. At the beginning of the linnorm's next turn, each creature that failed the Reflex save must succeed at a Basic DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Drained 1 (Drained 2 on a critical failure).

The cairn linnorm can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cairn Linnorm Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 41 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 6d6 Acid Damage damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 8d6 Acid Damage damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead spend an action to use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

lv7spells.name: True Seeing (Constant)
lv7spells.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion or transmutation in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

lv8spells.name: Freedom of Movement (Constant)
lv8spells.description:
You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to Escape an effect that has them Immobilized, Grabbed, or Restrained, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the freedom of movement spell.

{Spell Effect: Freedom of Movement}
